returned_task_numeric_error.note: Only returned, full-gold tasks; rejection has no numeric output. Not online risk.

click_order_changed.note: Click order only, not final hot-score ranking.

limitations: Development cases for known boundaries; not an independent test set or a sample of online risk.
No enterprise user data, real enterprise warehouse, or real inference.
SQLite permits aggregate bare columns that PostgreSQL may reject; these cases test the application boundary only.
No user-level records; cross-hour UV rejection has no fabricated dedup gold.
